answer: An operator that abandons 274 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the ledge forfeiture publishes up in the wharf totals with the dawn audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 35% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
